name: Wuxi Xinhongye Wire & Cable Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Xinhongye Wire & Cable Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of cables in China and internationally. It offers photovoltaic, energy vehicle, robot, energy storage, rail transit, and marine cables, as well as industrial electric wires, high-power charging guns, optoelectronic countermeasures equipment, and servo mechanism, motor, and system. The company is also involved in trading; electricity and heat production and supply; and software business.
